professionalSummary.text: Software engineer on the search indexing pipeline team since 2022, responsible for writing indexing jobs and schema changes under team engineering standards, with all changes documented in merge requests.
professionalSummary.witness: Software engineer on the search indexing pipeline team of a document collaboration company from 2022, writing the indexing jobs and the schema changes for the document and comment indexes under the team's engineering standard, with each change on a merge request in my name.

experienceHighlights.text: Proved all changes on replay corpus before merge, attaching documented replay results to merge requests, with results stored in pipeline repository for two years.
experienceHighlights.witness: Proved every change on the replay corpus before merge, attaching the replay result to the merge request; the replay results for the last two years sit in the pipeline repository.

experienceHighlights.text: Managed nine full index rebuilds through rebuild checklist with on-call engineer, with pipeline lead retaining rebuild go-ahead, documented on checklist.
experienceHighlights.witness: Brought nine full index rebuilds through the rebuild checklist with the on-call engineer; the rebuild go-ahead was the pipeline lead's each time, recorded on the rebuild checklist.

experienceHighlights.text: Answered customer-facing support engineers' questions about indexing delays in pipeline support channel, marking ownership of responses and referrals to pipeline lead.
experienceHighlights.witness: Answered the customer-facing support engineers' questions about indexing delays in the pipeline support channel, marking in each thread which answers were mine and which were referred to the pipeline lead.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented written boundaries and hand-over notes for every change in merge requests, specifying scope limitations and next steps for engineers.
experienceHighlights.witness: Left a written boundary and a hand-over note on every merge request, stating what the change did not cover and what the next engineer needed to know.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Provided two merge requests with replay results and boundary notes, one rebuild checklist with pipeline lead's go-ahead, and one month of pipeline support channel logs as verification.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: two merge requests with their replay results and boundary notes, one rebuild checklist with the pipeline lead's go-ahead, and one month of the pipeline support channel, with the repository references as a verification trail.

skills.text: Proficient in writing indexing jobs and schema changes under engineering standards, proving changes via replay corpus, managing rebuild checklists, and documenting boundaries.
skills.witness: Software engineer on the search indexing pipeline team of a document collaboration company from 2022, writing the indexing jobs and the schema changes for the document and comment indexes under the team's engineering standard, with each change on a merge request in my name. Proved every change on the replay corpus before merge, attaching the replay result to the merge request; the replay results for the last two years sit in the pipeline repository. Brought nine full index rebuilds through the rebuild checklist with the on-call engineer; the rebuild go-ahead was the pipeline lead's each time, recorded on the rebuild checklist. Left a written boundary and a hand-over note on every merge request, stating what the change did not cover and what the next engineer needed to know.
